reasoning_content: Let me check if the proxy is configured to route traffic to our server. The issue is the work proxy is routing to some internal service that's not running. Let me just verify our server is reachable from within.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Reload nginx
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("nginx -t && nginx -s reload 2>&1")
print("Nginx:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
